facets.description: translate_accelerator.rb `translate` lazy-loads only config.locale. Fallback locales (site default, :en) are loaded only by ApplicationController#set_locale, so in jobs, mailers, rake tasks and the console, fallback lookups return 'translation missing'.
The 'translation missing' result from a failed fallback lookup is frozen into the LRU cache under the normal key, so it stays wrong even after the fallback locales load.
The LRU cache key (key+locale+backend id) leaves out SiteSetting.default_locale or the fallback chain, so cached fallback text goes stale after the default locale changes.
